title: HELOC Quest: A HELOC is not free money
topic: HELOC rules: collateral, 65%/80% limits, variable rate, interest-only minimums, borrow with purpose, tax
hook: A HELOC is not free money.
logline: A homeowner opens a chest of gold that turns out to be chained to his own house, and has to learn three rules on the road before he can bring the chain home.
structure: Quest up a vertical overworld. Setup 0-16.9s (gold, chain, what a HELOC is, 65%/80% limits drawn inside the house), rising 16.9-34s (Trial 1 Prime Storm = variable rate, Trial 2 Balance Slime = interest-only hits for 0 damage), turn and peak 34-43.9s (renovation builds a room; palette drains to grey, only the gold chain keeps colour; REPAYMENT PLAN floods colour back), ending 43.9-57.3s (sage: tax-deductible? usually only if used to earn income; choice menu 'Thinking about a HELOC? MESSAGE ME'; chest lid closes into frame 1).
device: each HELOC rule becomes a game mechanic: a chain from gold to house in every shot, a hit that does 0 damage, an HP bar that will not move, palette collapse to grey, native 180x320 framebuffer at x6 with whole-frame x2 close-ups
rejectedStyles: microgame (needs 5-6 mini art engines, frenzy outruns caveats)
paper-popup (heavy 3D, house too close to the piggy-bank film)
rejectedStructures: item shop and inventory: static, no travel or turn
turn-based duel with a mimic chest: frames HELOC as a trap, one screen for 50s
lessons: PLAYBOOK 'How the first three reels measure up': it ends on a generic 'Message me' choice menu; cut it and loop instead.
Safe area: text runs down to about y 1480, below the y 1248 bottom limit.
AI label: Kokoro TTS voiceover, so apply Instagram's AI label when posting.
Audio bitrate: the _ig file carries about 192 kbps AAC; re-encode to 128 kbps if posting through the API.
Frame rate: 24 fps (pixel-rpg STYLE.md sets it); new work should be 30 fps.
